svg.data-fans: 4x hot-swappable 3+1 redundant, exhaust airflow; system front-to-back
svg.data-cpu: Intel Icelake-D 8-core @ 2.1 GHz (Standard) or Icelake-D 16-core @ 2.0 GHz (Premium), with VROC support
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO, ITU-T SyncE, IEEE 1588v2 (G.8265.1 default, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 with additional licence; T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC), Time Sensitive Networking, Class C accuracy
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS SMA in, 1PPS SMB in/out, 10MHz SMB in/out, ToD RJ45 in/out
svg.data-gnss: internal receiver for master clock implementations
svg.data-timing-cables: 50 ohm SMA coax with 1/4-36UNS-2B for GNSS; 50 ohm SMB coax with 10-32UNF-2A for 1PPS and 10MHz; shielded RJ45 for ToD
svg.data-nos: NOS integration is necessary to activate the timing features
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR, LR, ER; 10G SFP+ SR, LR, ER; 1G SFP SX, LX, EX (datasheet Compatible Transceivers Types)
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100G QSFP28 SR4, LR4, ER4, ZR4 (datasheet Compatible Transceivers Types)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G SFP+ SR, LR, ER (datasheet Compatible Transceivers Types; the two 10G management ports take the same optics as the SFP28 cages do at 10G)
svg.data-reset: recessed front-panel pinhole, warm-resets the host CPU when held for less than 10 seconds; HIG section 4.5 warns against sharp tools and asks for the UfiSpace fixture or a flat paperclip
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 55035; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; BSMI

rect.data-members: port-96 port-97 port-98 port-99 port-100 port-101

g.data-description: led-mgmt-l: the management jack's left corner lamp, drawn lit green in HIG Figure 8. THE HIG TABLES NO MANAGEMENT-PORT LED for this platform - the S9510-28DC and M3000-14XC guides do and this one does not - so the states here are the component default and not a transcription; led-mgmt-r: the management jack's right corner lamp; same absence of a vendor table as its left-hand twin, and the same component default
g.title: mgmt

g.data-description: HIG SYNC row - OFF (timing synchronization disabled or free-run), Solid Green (timing core synchronized to PTP phase or one of the external timing sources and frequency also locked), Blinking Green (synchronized to a PTP frequency profile or an external SyncE source), Solid Amber (acquiring or holdover), Blinking Amber (synchronization fail, or acquiring/holdover timed out)
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG SYS row - OFF (no power), Solid Green (host CPU/BMC boot complete), Solid Amber (power is up but host CPU/BMC boot failed). Three rows only: this table gives SYS no blinking state
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: HIG FAN row - OFF (fan modules not initialized), Solid Green (all fan modules working normally), Blinking Amber (fan fail: one or more fans need service)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG PS0 row - OFF (no power), Solid Green (PSU0 working normally), Blinking Amber (PSU0 fail, PSU0 needs service). This platform gives each supply its own lamp rather than sharing one PWR lamp
g.title: led-ps0

g.data-description: HIG PS1 row - OFF (no power), Solid Green (PSU1 working normally), Blinking Amber (PSU1 fail, PSU1 needs service)
g.title: led-ps1

g.data-description: HIG ID row - OFF (no power), Blinking Blue (enable beacon feature). Two rows, and the blue is the only colour this lamp is documented to show
g.title: led-id

g.data-description: the pair the datasheet calls '2 x 10G SFP+ management ports', printed 0 and 1 in their own sequence above their own two-row block
g.title: mport-0

g.data-description: the pair the datasheet calls '2 x 10G SFP+ management ports', printed 0 and 1 in their own sequence above their own two-row block
